time_unit: dimensionless developmental step; not a calendar day

architecture.main_apex_history: Prior apex arrest represented as an assumed starting architecture, not predicted from a hormone model

event.selection: Fixed organ IDs selected below an assumed 0.38 m boundary at the pre-event snapshot
event.status: Constructed comparison event; not measured grower history or a cutting simulation

status.geometry: Developmental architecture hypothesis informed by reference photographs; not fitted to a longitudinal specimen
status.mechanics: Per-organ mass and beam rigidity exported with assumed material values. Whole-plant contact is not solved.
status.growth: Organ birth and age-dependent expansion; no carbon, water, hormone or light-response solver
status.variation: Coupled specimen vigor and local variation; not a measured population distribution
status.flowers: Simplified external envelopes, not calibrated inflorescence development
